title: Working, Making, Creating in Public... and Private

reader_summary.headline: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6&Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6&Z podcast. I'm Sonal, and I'm super excited to do one of our special book launch episodes for the new book coming out just this week. And so one theme we also pull the threads on in this episode is about how the learnings of open source communities do and don't apply to the passion economy and creator communities as well..
